name: mysql-9.7-join-aggregate
query:
SELECT c.country, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.total) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'pending'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
